weak.desc: 同一個字反覆拼錯：choose 曾出現三種不同錯拼方式；跨篇重複出現的個人記憶點錯字：prasious(precious)、choise(choice)、achivement(achievement)、addvice/addvise
although...but 冗贅並用；In my concern/angle 代替 In my opinion

explain.rule: 這種錯誤是直接把中文的思考邏輯或搭配方式套進英文，英文母語者不會這樣講。要練習的不是文法，而是「換句話說」的能力——想到中文詞先問自己「英文母語者真的會這樣講嗎」，而不是逐字翻譯。
examples: ✗ In my concern / In my angle → ✓ In my opinion（依我看）
✗ although...but 同時使用 → ✓ 兩個連接詞只能擇一：Although X, Y. 或 X, but Y.

weak.desc: 如 team have、website appears、every words surround 等

explain.rule: 動詞要跟主詞的人稱、單複數一致。單數主詞（he/she/it/單一名詞）動詞加 -s；複數主詞或 I/you/we/they 動詞不加 -s。集合名詞（team, family）通常當單數看待。
examples: ✗ The team have a plan. → ✓ The team has a plan.
✗ Every word surround me. → ✓ Every word surrounds me.

weak.desc: You/Your/If/It/When/Life/The 等字在句中被誤大寫，已確認為系統性錯誤，非單一字詞問題
敘事段落中過去式與現在式（含 will）混用

explain.rule: 描述過去發生的事，整段都要用過去式，不要中途切換回現在式或未來式（will）。可以先確認「這件事是不是已經發生過」，是的話全程用過去式。
examples: ✗ When I was young, I will fall asleep in class. → ✓ ...I would fall asleep in class.
✗ He come back and everyone didn't complain. → ✓ He came back...

weak.desc: 如 everyone effort to do something，已確認為穩定重複錯誤

explain.rule: effort 是名詞（努力，一份心力），不是動詞。「努力做某事」要用 make an effort to V 或直接用動詞 try / work hard。
examples: ✗ Everyone effort to run. → ✓ Everyone makes an effort to run.
✗ I effort to learn English. → ✓ I try hard to learn English.

weak.desc: efficient/effective、progress/process、contract/contrast、interesting/interest、exciting/stimulate 當名詞用；incredible/incredulous（選錯字導致情緒意思說反，非拼字問題）

words.note: 合約/收縮 vs. 對比
令人驚嘆的 vs. 不敢置信的（意思幾乎相反）
形容詞、動詞誤用為名詞

weak.desc: 客觀描述段落誤植主觀意見

explain.rule: 題目通常要求「先客觀描述，再給個人意見」分兩段處理。寫客觀描述段落時，先問自己：這句話是在講圖表/情境本身的內容，還是已經在講「我」的想法？如果太早出現 I think / In my opinion，代表跳段了。
examples: 客觀段落應該像：The chart shows that 76.9% of students spend money on making friends.（描述數據）
而不是一開始就寫：I think making friends is important to me.（提早進入主觀意見）

weak.desc: 所有格 its 與縮寫 it's 混用

explain.rule: its（無撇號）是所有格，「它的」；it's（有撇號）是 it is 或 it has 的縮寫。判斷方法：把 it's 展開成 it is，唸起來通順就是 it's，不通順就是 its。
examples: ✗ its delivery fee is cheap and it's cheap → 應為：its delivery fee is cheap
✓ It's raining today.（It is raining）
✓ The dog wagged its tail.（牠的尾巴）

weak.desc: 多個獨立子句以逗號直接連接，未使用句號或連接詞

explain.rule: 兩個各自能獨立成句的子句，不能只用逗號連接（這叫 comma splice）。要嘛用句號分開、用分號、或加連接詞（and, but, because, so...）。
examples: ✗ It was raining, we stayed home. → ✓ It was raining, so we stayed home. / It was raining. We stayed home.
✗ I like it, it is cheap. → ✓ I like it because it is cheap.

weak.cat: worth to V 結構錯誤
weak.desc: 應為 worth + V-ing，如 worth to afford 應為 worth enduring

explain.rule: worth 後面接動詞時，要用動名詞（V-ing），不能用 to V。「值得做某事」= worth V-ing。
examples: ✗ It is worth to try. → ✓ It is worth trying.
✗ worth to afford → ✓ worth enduring

weak.desc: 如 chat to（應為with）、interest to（應為in）、fit to（應為for）、impression to（應為on）

explain.rule: 很多動詞、形容詞後面固定搭配特定介係詞，這種是「固定用法」要當作一個整體背，不能用中文邏輯去猜。
examples: chat with someone（不是 chat to）
fit for someone（不是 fit to）
interested in something（不是 interested to）

weak.desc: 如 I still be present、it will hard to、is prepare 等

explain.rule: 當句子的動詞是「形容詞」或「Ving/p.p.」時，前面一定要有 be 動詞（am/is/are/was/were）撐住句子，不能省略。
examples: ✗ I still be present. → ✓ I am still present.
✗ It will hard to chat. → ✓ It will be hard to chat.

weak.desc: motivate/motive、considering/consideration、efficient/efficiency 等；tolerant/tolerance

weak.cat: 關係子句多餘主詞代名詞
weak.desc: 如 that it seem、that it use、which...it，跨三篇出現，2026/08 正式確認

explain.rule: 用 that / which / who 開頭的關係子句，句子裡已經包含了主詞的角色，後面不能再重複加一個 it / he 等代名詞。
examples: ✗ Yawoo that it use no-contact service → ✓ Yawoo, which uses no-contact service
✗ the theme, which people will like it → ✓ the theme, which people will like

weak.desc: most X 應為 X-est，如 most clear 應為 clearest、most easy 應為 easiest

explain.rule: 形容詞最高級的判斷依「音節數」：1-2 音節的字，字尾直接加 -est；3 音節（含）以上的字，前面加 most，不能加 -est。
examples: 1音節：clear → clearest（不是 most clear）
2音節：easy → easiest（不是 most easy）
3音節以上：beautiful → most beautiful；important → most important

weak.desc: 如 to get and keeping、cutting and decide

explain.rule: 當兩個動詞用 and 連接、共用同一個結構時，前後的動詞形式要一致（都是 to V，或都是 V-ing），不能一個 to V 一個 V-ing。
examples: ✗ to get new friends and keeping the friendship → ✓ to get new friends and keep the friendship
✗ cutting video and decide the theme → ✓ cutting video and deciding the theme

weak.desc: As me recall 應為 As I；make my 應為 make me

explain.rule: 代名詞在句子中當主詞要用主格（I, he, she），當受詞或介係詞後面要用受格（me, him, her）。
examples: ✗ As me recall → ✓ As I recall
✗ It will make my not-alone → ✓ It will make me feel not alone

weak.desc: 如 many food 應為 much food

explain.rule: 不可數名詞（如 food, money, advice）前面不能用 many，要用 much 或 a lot of；也不能加 s 變複數。
examples: ✗ many food → ✓ much food / a lot of food
✗ many advices → ✓ much advice / some advice

weak.cat: 冠詞誤加（抽象/泛指名詞）
weak.desc: the friendship、the nature 等抽象或泛指名詞前誤加 the

explain.rule: 當抽象名詞（friendship, nature, happiness）是泛指、不特定某一個時，前面不加 the。只有在特指「某一種、某一次」的狀況才加 the。
examples: ✗ the friendship is important → ✓ friendship is important（泛指友情這個概念）
✗ trust the nature → ✓ trust nature

weak.desc: 與句中誤大寫並存出現，顯示大小寫規則尚未真正掌握，而非單純粗心
以 measure 代替「設施/活動」一詞，非拼字問題，需口頭直接教正確說法

explain.rule: 有些字看起來好像可以用，但實際上不是英語母語者會用的詞，這種不是拼字或文法問題，是選錯字，需要直接記住正確的說法。
examples: ✗ amusement measure → ✓ amusement facilities / rides（遊樂設施）
✗ thrilling measure → ✓ thrilling rides / activities

weak.desc: slap on my face 應為 slap myself；force me 應為 force myself（新觀察，尚待再次確認）

explain.rule: 當動作的對象就是自己時，要用反身代名詞（myself, yourself, himself...），不能只用一般代名詞或介係詞代替。
examples: ✗ slap on my face → ✓ slap myself in the face
✗ force me to stay awake → ✓ force myself to stay awake

weak.desc: 多篇皆有結構打結、無法確定原意的句子，依標準不猜測，列出待老師詢問學生

explain.rule: 這類句子不是單一文法點的問題，而是整句邏輯、指涉對象或想表達的意思本身不清楚。這種情況建議直接口頭問學生「這句你原本想講什麼」，不要用猜的去改，避免曲解原意。
examples: 例如「the peer glance to what when you go to get second round」——結構跟邏輯都需要學生親自澄清才能準確修正

weak.desc: than 與 then 混用，同一篇出現兩次（Back than 應為 Back then；We haven't been touch since than 應為 since then）

explain.rule: than 用在「比較」（than 前後常有比較級形容詞，如 more...than, better than）；then 用在「時間先後」（然後、當時）。唸出來發音不同，但因為長得像常打錯。
examples: ✓ Back then, I thought nothing could tear us apart.（那時候）
✓ He is taller than me.（比…更高）

weak.desc: 指稱對象前後不一致，如 breaking off his friendship 應為 our friendship（這段友情是雙方的，不是單方的）；同篇也出現 my best friends 與全文單一朋友的敘事對象數量不一致

explain.rule: 代名詞（his/her/their/our...）要跟它所指的對象一致。寫之前先確認：這件事情/這段關係是屬於誰的？是單方的還是雙方共有的？
examples: ✗ breaking off his friendship（這段友情是雙方的） → ✓ breaking off our friendship
確認全文的敘事對象是單數還是複數，代名詞要跟著一致

portfolio.title: 食物外送平台比較（UBirds / Yawoo / Foodbear）
portfolio.prompt: 依表格描述三個食物外送平台特色，並說明自己是否會使用、會選哪個平臺及原因。
portfolio.original:
After the Covid 19 trend, more and more food delivery services website appears like a gress. In these picture, these website are using own wan to survice in delivery war. For example, the UBird's feture is they have wide goods and spend 100$ geting the delivery fee free these two ways can attract students or others people who don't have much budget. Another is Yawoo that it use the way is the no contact service and specialtic times make delivery fee free. I think the not touch services can be the attractive way to appeal the people who easily feel shy in the communication, but the specialtic times make delivery fee free is not the best way to draw peoples who will become the regular visitor even if it's delivery fee just cost $24. The last one is Food bear it is the website that it has the most clear intention for the high spend costumers. The Foodbear coolabrate with the high rate restaurant and it's delivery fee is the most expensive in these three delivery website.
For me, I won't use the food delivery website because I enjoy that exploring in the street find some new restaurants. In this progress, although I will trapped by some dishes that not taste good, I still be present when I find treasure restaurants. It is a sence of achivement, like a pirate find the treasure. However, if I want to be a couch potato, I will use food delivery services, and I wil choose the UBirds because I am not a rich man.
portfolio.corrected:
After the Covid-19 trend, more and more food delivery service websites have appeared like grass. In this picture, these websites are using their own way to survive in the delivery war. For example, UBird's feature is that they have a wide range of goods and offer free delivery when you spend $100 — these two ways can attract students or other people who don't have much budget. Another is Yawoo, which uses no-contact delivery and offers free delivery during specific hours. I think the no-contact service can be an attractive way to appeal to people who easily feel shy in communication, but the specific-hour free delivery is not the best way to draw people who will become regular visitors, even though its delivery fee only costs $24. The last one is Foodbear, which has the clearest intention of targeting high-spending customers. Foodbear collaborates with high-end restaurants, and its delivery fee is the most expensive among these three delivery websites.
For me, I won't use food delivery websites because I enjoy exploring the streets to find new restaurants. In this process, although I will be disappointed by some dishes that don't taste good, 〔語意待確認：I am still present when I find treasure restaurants〕. It is a sense of achievement, like a pirate finding treasure. However, if I want to be a couch potato, I will use food delivery services, and I will choose UBirds because I am not a rich man.
portfolio.note: its/it's 混淆兩次；progress/process 混淆；關係子句多餘代名詞（that it use / that it has）首次觀察到的雛形；最高級 most clear 應為 clearest。

portfolio.corrected:
In this picture, most of the pocket money is used to get friends or to have fun based on their own interests. In this 3C era, social media is common, so getting new friends is not a difficult thing nowadays. Along with the increasing number of friends, the cost will increase too. On the other hand, an increasing number of friends will let pocket money be spent on interests and trends. In my opinion, most of my friends have the same interests as me, so we can have a conversation. If the interest is the electricity between friends, the trend of memes is the grease in conversations with strangers. Since memes are common in the world, if strangers have seen a meme before, you can talk about this famous meme with others. You won't be embarrassed. Also, makeup can give strangers a good impression, and it will increase the chance of making friends. So the cost of these things is necessary. The cost of those things is unexpected.
In my opinion, my pocket money spending might be similar to this picture. But the difference is that my savings rate will be higher than the snack and interest categories. Maybe it is a feature of Taiwanese culture — adults always let us save money in the bank, including pocket money, lucky money, and so forth. But the unchanged thing is that I will spend a lot of money to make new friends and keep the friendship. Regardless of what era you are in, friendship is still an important thing.
portfolio.note: 句首該大寫卻用小寫（and Make up / so the cost）與句中誤大寫（Social, The, Make）並存；In my angle 代替 In my opinion；不定詞/動名詞不平行（to get...and keeping）；抽象名詞前冠詞誤加（the friendship）。

portfolio.title: 分工合作與校運會接力賽
portfolio.prompt: 說明分工合作的好處（或壞處），並舉自己或他人團體合作的經驗支持看法。
portfolio.original:
Nowadays, having team-work ability has been the neccesary thing, not only working in workplaces, but also studying in the school. Cooperating with others can arrange right peoples to right ways. It can effectively increase efficient. And It's the good way to got a progress. When You converse about shortcoming in the team conversation, Your classmate or colleague will give the objective addvice to you. Therefore, You can notice your own weakness, and you can improve it with specific addvise. However, these all things are based on that you have good cooperators. If your team have peoples who is lazy or not effort. It will cause others teamate must handle their work, and that will waste the time, which you depand cooperation to save. As a result, it even have better working in ownself.
As me recall, It's the school sports day. Every one is prepare to exhibit sports ability in this day. And the most popular thing is relay race, every one effort to run one the way. Suddenlly, our class runner is trumble. Everyone is care about his condition, but he still finish the race. When he come back, everyone didn't complain. Everyone encourage others teamates, and give some addvise, which can boost the speed. At the end, even if we don't have a good grade, but I saw the best race team in the world. As the saying goes "Teamwork is the most powerful energy in this world", I eventually understand until that day, because when I saw that everyone effort to do something, I will have the endless power exploring my body.
portfolio.corrected:
Nowadays, having teamwork ability has become a necessary thing, not only for working in workplaces but also for studying in school. Cooperating with others can assign the right people to the right roles. It can effectively increase efficiency, and it's a good way to make progress. When you talk about your shortcomings in a team discussion, your classmates or colleagues will give you objective advice. Therefore, you can notice your own weaknesses and improve them with specific advice. However, all these things are based on the fact that you have good cooperators. If your team has people who are lazy or not hardworking, it will cause other teammates to handle their work, which will waste the time that cooperation was meant to save. As a result, it is even better to work by yourself.
As I recall, it was the school sports day. Everyone was preparing to show their sports ability that day, and the most popular event was the relay race — everyone made an effort to run all the way. Suddenly, our class runner stumbled. Everyone cared about his condition, but he still finished the race. When he came back, no one complained. Everyone encouraged their teammates and gave advice that could boost their speed. In the end, even though we didn't get a good grade, I saw the best race team in the world. As the saying goes, "Teamwork is the most powerful energy in this world." I finally understood this on that day, because when I saw everyone making an effort to do something, I had endless power exploding inside me.
portfolio.note: You/Your 句中大寫三次；effort 當動詞三次；addvice/addvise 拼字混用三次；although/even if...but 冗贅；if 子句句號斷句造成片段；代名詞格位錯誤 As me recall。內容敘事生動，是這批裡content分數最高的一篇。

Nowadays, being a Youtuber has become a popular dream for many teenagers in this era. portfolio.corrected:
〔第1句語意待確認〕Looking back, my life is full of regrets. If you ask me, what is the biggest regret in my life? I think it would be that I was not hardworking enough in English. When I was a junior high school student, I would fall asleep in English classes because I thought that English would be boring and useless in the future. Although the English teacher always emphasized English was important, I felt anxious about 〔語意待確認：these stable expressions〕. Until I graduated in senior high school, I realized how important this subject was. As 〔語意待確認：words rate of difficult〕 rose, I couldn't even read the questions in the exam. Every word surrounded my messy brain like birds. In addition, when I looked at anything related to English, I would feel sleepy and lazy. These previous habits always affected my study efficiency. 〔語意待確認：Those bad habits spent my precious studying time to having transform.〕

Looking back, my life is full of many regrets. I am always plagued by those unforgettable decisions when I am lying on the bed. One of my biggest regrets is having a big argument with my best friend. When I was a junior high school student, I had a good friend who graduated from the same school as me. Although we were just friends, we were more like family.
